# SolidNumber

> SolidNumber is an AI-powered business infrastructure platform that automates calls, scheduling, payments, and CRM operations through 65+ tools and 116 AI agents.

SolidNumber (Solid#) provides end-to-end business automation for service businesses, contractors, and enterprises across 51+ industries. The platform integrates with leading payment processors (Stripe, Square, PayPal), CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot), and communication tools to streamline operations.

## Key Topics

- AI agents
- Business automation

- Payment processing
- Call answering
